# Stack Consulting AI

> Practical AI automation, custom websites, and 24/7 AI phone agents for small businesses. Independent consulting practice based in Orange County, California.

You don't need more AI tools. You need a better stack. Stack Consulting AI designs and deploys AI receptionists, business automation, and conversion-focused websites for small businesses that want systems their team will actually use — not another dashboard to babysit.

## About

- Independent AI consulting practice run by Chad McCluskey
- Based in Orange County, California; serves SoCal in-person and remote nationwide
- Specialties: AI voice receptionists, n8n/Make/Zapier automation, Next.js websites, managed IT for small business

## Services

- [Services overview](https://stackconsultingai.com/services): full service menu and how engagements work
- [Business automation](https://stackconsultingai.com/services/business-automation): workflow automation with n8n, Make, Zapier, and custom integrations
- [Web development](https://stackconsultingai.com/services/web-development): Next.js and Tailwind sites built for SEO and conversion
- [Ecommerce](https://stackconsultingai.com/services/ecommerce): Shopify and custom storefront builds
- [Maintenance](https://stackconsultingai.com/services/maintenance): ongoing site care, monitoring, and performance tuning
- [Guest WiFi](https://stackconsultingai.com/services/guest-wifi): UniFi-based captive portal and guest network setup

## AI Receptionist

- [AI Receptionist](https://stackconsultingai.com/ai-receptionist): 24/7 phone agent that answers, qualifies, books appointments, transfers humans when needed, and emails you the transcript. Sub-1-second answer time. Live demo callable from the page.
